svg.text: 07 · Attendees in Discord: few commands, each a door to the page
Use case: an attendee asks the bot what is on, where the food is and how to open the hub; the answers are private and one tap from the page that does it (#123).

svg.text: A · Desktop: /food, /now and /hub; every answer is private and links to the page

This server is not connected to an event.
An event admin connects it from the event's Discord page.
Food is not on at Demo Event.
Ask the crew; the command goes away within a minute.
Sign in to Demo Event once to use /announce.
Then your @Crew role brings the rights.
You need the Announce right for /announce.
Your roles: @Attendee. Ask an event admin.
Demo Event did not answer in time.
Nothing was sent. Try again in a moment.
